title: Austin Election Results Certified
summary:
*   This special meeting convened solely to officially count and certify the results of the Austin city election held on April 6.
*   The final vote tally confirmed the election of five individuals: Mrs. Stuart (Emma) Long, Ben White, Tom Miller, Lester E. Palmer, and Wesley Pearson.
*   These individuals were formally declared the new leaders for Austin, authorized to begin their two-year terms of service on May 15, 1957.

The Mayor announced that this meeting was called for the purpose of canvassing the votes
of a General Election of Councilmen, held on the 6th day of April, 1957.
Councilman Long was absent due to illness in her family.
The Council appointed Councilman Palmer to initial the returns as they were canvassed by
the members.
The Council canvassed the returns.
Councilman White offered the following resolution and moved its adoption: (RESOLUTION)
